instruction: Write a complete XDP/eBPF C program that drops IPv4 TCP packets whose destination port is 23 (Telnet) and passes every other packet. Handle variable-length IPv4 headers and check all packet bounds.
requirements: Check bounds before every packet-header access

tests.name: positive_telnet_drop
tests.description: IPv4 TCP to port 23 should be dropped

tests.name: negative_http_pass
tests.description: IPv4 TCP to port 80 should pass

tests.name: negative_udp_pass
tests.description: IPv4 UDP to port 23 should pass

tests.name: boundary_truncated_pass
tests.description: Truncated Ethernet packet (<14 bytes) should safely pass
